description: This file defines a mock class RpcControllerMock for testing purposes, which implements the google::protobuf::RpcController interface. It uses Google Mock to mock the methods of the interface, enabling unit testing of components that depend on RpcController.

classes.name: RpcControllerMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of google::protobuf::RpcController for testing purposes, using Google Mock.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the controller to its initial state.

methods.name: Failed
methods.description: Returns whether the RPC has failed.

methods.name: ErrorText
methods.description: Returns the error text if the RPC failed.

methods.name: SetFailed
methods.description: Sets the RPC as failed with a reason string.

methods.name: IsCanceled
methods.description: Checks if the RPC has been canceled.

methods.name: NotifyOnCancel
methods.description: Registers a callback to be called if the RPC is canceled.
